Open browser: github.com -> top-right avatar -> Settings.
In left sidebar: Developer settings -> Personal access tokens -> Tokens (classic).
Click "Generate token" and copy token immediately.
Back in app: paste token into PAT field and click "Connect with token".
Method 2: OAuth Device Flow - step by step
In GitHub: Settings -> Developer settings -> OAuth Apps -> New OAuth App.
Click "Register application" and then copy the "Client ID".
In app: Settings tab -> field "GitHub OAuth Client ID (Device Flow)" -> paste Client ID.
Go back to GitHub tab -> click "Start Device Flow".
In browser visit shown URL, enter code, click "Continue" and then "Authorize".
Method 3: One-click login - step by step
If not installed yet: install GitHub CLI (gh) from cli.github.com.
Keep app open on GitHub tab and click "Sign in with GitHub".
Browser opens: complete GitHub login and confirm 2FA if needed.
If asked: allow access for GitHub CLI (Authorize).
After approval, app returns automatically and connects your account.
Note: this method does not require your own OAuth Client ID in app settings.
Only for Method 2 (Device flow): OAuth app client ID required. Method 3 (one-click) does not need your own client ID.
